question: NVIDIA H100 PCIe 版本（非 SXM）是本地工作站部署 27B 模型的‘甜点’数据中心级方案。单卡价格约 $25k-$30k，功耗 700W，需要定制水冷或强力风冷机箱（额外成本 ~$1k）。相比 2x A100 (PCIe) 方案，H100 单卡在 NVLink 互联缺失的情况下，通过高效的单卡内存管理可实现更低的 Token 延迟抖动，适合对稳定性要求极高的生产环境。

sources.title: PDF NVIDIA H100 PCIe GPU
sources.snippet: The NVIDIA® H100 Tensor Core GPU delivers unprecedented acceleration to power the world's highest-performing elastic data centers for AI, data analytics, and high-performance computing (HPC) applications. NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core technology supports a broad range of math precisions, providing a single accelerator for every compute workload.

sources.snippet: H100 PCIe, SXM and NVL in one table: CUDA cores, VRAM, bandwidth and dense vs sparse TFLOPS. Plus how it compares to the A100 and H200, and rental costs.

sources.title: PDF Nvidia H100 Nvl Gpu
sources.snippet: The NVIDIA H100 NVL operates unconstrained up to its maximum thermal design power (TDP) level of 400 W to accelerate applications that require the fastest computational speed and highest data throughput. The NVIDIA H100 NVL debuts the world's highest PCIe card memory bandwidth of nearly 4,000 gigabytes per second (GBps).
